# Analysis Centrality and Resilience


This section describes the lane of the workflow that <span class="font-color">**analyse centrality and resilience**</span>. 

* We <span class= "font-color">**transform into graph**</span> the road network from OSM using openrouteservice, which finally led to create the pre-disaster network. 
* The flood extent is used to <span class="font-color"> **extract the difference**</span> with the pre-disaster network obtaining the post-disaster network graph. 

![Fig.1 Flowchart](data/figures/obtaining_routable_network.svg)

The pre-processing phase is finished providing the main objects of the study, the flood extent, municipalities, road network and hospitals. We used these objects in the centrality and accessibility study.
